result.description: Data enrichment and GTM automation platform: waterfall enrichment across 100+ providers, audiences, tables, and AI agents (Claygent).
result.auth_detail: Personal API key in `clay-api-key` header, tied to a Clay user and workspace. Created in app (API and CLI > API keys) or via `clay api-keys create`. No OAuth for the public API documented.
result.access_detail: Pricing table lists "Build with Clay via CLI / API" on every tier including Free (100 search results / 30 days), but pricing FAQ lists "Clay API access" under Enterprise. Docs mark only Tables as Enterprise. Free signup likely gets a key with a small quota; some features (Tables, higher volume) are Enterprise. Plan gating is unclear and sources conflict.
result.api_notes: Base https://api.clay.com/public/v0. Endpoints: me, credits, searches (query-mode), routines/functions run and batch runs, Audiences privacy deletion, Tables query (Enterprise), workflow runs search (beta). Pagination, errors, rate limits, webhooks docs plus an OpenAPI spec. Not a full CRUD API over tables or rows.
result.blocker: Plan gating for API is ambiguous (table says Free has API, FAQ says Enterprise); API surface is narrow (searches, routines, credits); Tables is Enterprise-only. Official MCP page gives no public endpoint or auth details.
